title: An incident becomes a fix
summary: Break orders in production with a fault flag; an alarm opens an incident issue and an agent ships the fix.

steps.title: Put normal traffic on production
steps.narration: Simulated customers keep ordering, so the fault shows up as real failed requests.

steps.title: Switch on a known fault
steps.narration: The fault flag faultFailOrders makes some order requests fail, as a real bug would. It is changed in AppConfig, with no deploy.

steps.title: An alarm fires
steps.narration: The error rate climbs and a CloudWatch alarm goes off. EventBridge starts the incident job in GitHub.

wait.description: A production alarm goes into ALARM

steps.title: The incident agent opens an issue
steps.narration: An agent reads the logs, recent deploys and commits, and opens an issue with the evidence, labeled incident.

steps.title: An agent writes the fix
steps.narration: Triage hands the incident to an agent, which writes the fix and a test that would have caught it.

wait.description: The agent opens a PR for the incident

steps.title: The fix passes checks and merges
steps.narration: The fix goes through exactly the same checks and merge queue as any other change.

steps.title: The fix deploys
steps.narration: Merging deploys the fix to staging and then production.

wait.subject: prod
wait.description: The fix is live in production

steps.title: The alarm clears
steps.narration: Requests succeed again and the alarm returns to OK. From alarm to fix, nobody wrote code by hand.
